statement.excerpt: At some point investors — even the braindead fuckwits who have been inflating the AI bubble — will begin to question mounting R&D costs (which is where AI token burn is usually hidden) when the company’s revenue growth fails to follow.
statement.document_title: AI's Economics Don't Make Sense [Ad Free]

from_speaker: will begin to question mounting R&D costs
when the company’s revenue growth fails to follow
our_interpretation: The plain reading is public investor or investment-analyst scrutiny of rising R&D expenses attributable at least partly to internal AI token use, after revenue fails to keep pace.
Revenue need not decline; sustained R&D growth exceeding revenue growth can meet the stated condition.
General criticism of data-center capital spending alone does not establish the narrower token-related R&D claim.
At some point supplies no deadline. The six-month deadline in the following sentence belongs to a different claim.
criteria.support_condition: After the antecedent is documented for an identifiable company, a dated investor statement or earnings-call question explicitly challenges the relevant R&D spending or its justification.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No finite period of investor silence disproves this deadline-free forecast. A contrary outcome would require a decisive event permanently foreclosing the forecast for its stated scope.
